definitions: To hold someone closely in one's arms, especially as a sign of affection, welcome, or comfort.
To accept or support a belief, theory, or change willingly and enthusiastically.
To include or contain something as a part of a whole.
To take up an opportunity or challenge eagerly.
examples: They embraced warmly after a long separation.
The company decided to embrace new technologies.
The study embraces a wide range of topics.
She was quick to embrace the chance to travel.
